Workload Group Resource Update Workload Group
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/workloadGroups/:workloadGroupId

Updates the workload group for an organization based on the specified ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
workloadGroupId
int32
REQUIRED

The workload group ID

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
404
500

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

A unique identifier assigned to the workload group

name
string

The name of the workload group

description
string

The description of the workload group

expressionJson
object
expression
string

The workload group expression containing tag types, tags, and their relationships.

lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp when the workload group was last modified

lastModifiedBy
object
